equity_accounted_rows.structure: Equity-accounted joint venture (Note 18 p194); MPACT holds 50% effective interest. Not in audited Investment Properties Portfolio Statement p154-159.
equity_accounted_rows.audited_segment_note: Note 31 Segment Reporting p220: TPG (Korea) column shows gross revenue '-', property operating expenses '-', segment net property income '-'. The only income metric the audited financials disclose for TPG is 'Share of profit of a joint venture' S$6,380k (FY2024; S$9,425k FY2023) - a post-tax equity-accounted profit share, NOT net property income. Note 18 p194 states the JV is not individually material, so no summarised JV financials are presented.
equity_accounted_rows.source_detail: TPG property card p65 lines labelled NET PROPERTY INCOME / GROSS REVENUE (footnote 1 'Based on MPACT's 50% effective interest'); corroborated in SGD by Financial Review contribution tables p37 (S$9.3M NPI / S$12.1M GR).
equity_accounted_rows.basis_flag: attributable_basis_income flag added to the row; figures are 50% effective-interest, NOT 100%-of-property, and are not audited. NLA 478,461 sq ft is on a 100% basis (card footnote 2).
